item.title: ⛔ Exchange Web Services (EWS) Full Retirement — All Exchange Online — 2027-04-01
item.description:
🟠 140 days remaining — Full and final retirement of EWS from Exchange Online. No EWS connections will be accepted from any application after this date.
Migration: Complete migration of all EWS applications to Microsoft Graph API.
